caption: The drawing is composed in black ink on a beige background and depicts a wrought iron balcony railing with highly ornate, symmetrical scrollwork featuring many spirals, curves, and floral motifs. At the center of the railing, there is a large heart-shaped or shield-like element that contains a stylized letter "A." The railing is shown in front elevation, positioned above a horizontal base and beneath a horizontal top rail. Directly behind the railing, two windows with divided panes and brickwork are partially visible, depicted with simple hatched and line shading. The drawing is bordered by a thin single-line frame with small square embellishments at each corner. In the lower right corner, the handwritten text “The Pontalba Building” appears.
title: Cast Iron Balcony Rail
